scope: src/components/ui.tsx: explicit web outlineStyle and rounded outer focus outline
reviewedProperties: Packet parsing narrows unknown records and strings; source, branch, menu and item IDs are unique within their applicable packet collections, and duplicate branch/menu references are rejected.
Every selected branch menu must resolve locally or in the pilot and declare that branch as an owner. Referenced menu/item sources and selected branch sources resolve before output generation.
Relative JSON shard paths are checked against the research root, and a shared visited set prevents repeated file processing and cycles.
Index totals explicitly count potentially overlapping branch records, menu sources and source food rows, retain complete:false, and do not publish app records or call Google.
CSV cells quote embedded quotes and prefix LF/CR/tab, whitespace/BOM-prefixed formula starts, and supported fullwidth formula prefixes.
Atomic rename retries only EPERM/EACCES/EBUSY for at most eight attempts, with awaited capped delays, immediate propagation of other errors and temporary-file cleanup in finally.

Explicit solid outlineStyle is web-only. The inner outline remains zero width while the rounded outer accent focus perimeter remains independent of error-border state and forwards existing focus/blur callbacks.
